intro: In Elwynn's mines, kobolds carry Large Candles on their heads for light and wax. Their flames guide them through dark tunnels, and apothecaries value the wax.

p: Kobolds use candle flame to find their way through the dark shafts beneath Elwynn Forest. They fasten the tapers to their heads, and Kobold Miners, Tunnelers, and Geomancers defend them fiercely from intruders. Though crudely made, the Large Candles carried in Fargodeep Mine and Jasperlode Mine hold valuable wax. Surface tradesmen cannot easily produce it in bulk, so the candles are both tools for the kobolds and a commodity for alchemists.

William Pestle, an apothecary operative from Stormwind City, gathers Large Candles at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. His family runs an apothecary, and he needs rendered wax for its concoctions, balms, and ointments. Pestle hires passing adventurers to clear the infested mines and take candles from the kobolds.
